caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate metal object, primarily rendered in shades of grey, resembling an andiron or fire dog, which is used to hold logs in a fireplace. The object consists of three main curved legs at the front that are decorated with leaf-like and scroll motifs, with rounded feet. The central vertical shaft extends upward, displaying a ring structure at the top supported by intricate scrollwork and embellishments. The base of the shaft features additional carved details and a rectangular panel with an emblem or coat of arms. Extending horizontally from the ornate front, a long, straight support arm projects backward and appears simpler in design compared to the front. The entire composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
